narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

jen.instruct: Bubbly young woman in love, defensive and fast, laughing it off.

kim.instruct: Calm, flat, awkward young woman at a doorway, polite but deadly serious.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's girls' night and your Scorpio friend just stopped blinking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jen just introduced her new boyfriend Tom.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Vera and she's loyal and intense and very quiet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She knows your password and you never told her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She found his ex online in eight minutes.

lines.speaker: jen
lines.text: Stop it Vera, he's a nice guy!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vera nods slowly and writes something in her notebook.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Jen ignores her and life is great.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Flowers and dinners and weekend trips and matching sweaters.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the doorbell rings.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's his other girlfriend wearing the same sweater.

lines.speaker: kim
lines.text: Hi, I think we need to talk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tom tries to leave through the closet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vera is already pouring three glasses of wine because she saw this coming.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What's going on inside a Scorpio?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a dark room with a corkboard and red string.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every photo on it is labelled suspect.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's a filing cabinet marked evidence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A padlock labelled secrets and the key is gone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a counter marked days since I forgave.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It has never once moved past zero.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jen and Kim become best friends and Vera pins a new photo.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's your new coworker and Vera doesn't blink.
